$description: Torviello design tokens, sliced from the approved brand board (torviello-design/brand/reference-board.png). W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft format. Primitives are the board values; semantic aliases are the only tokens components may consume.

midnight.$description: Board: Midnight. Base surface of every dark surface.

orange.$description: Board: Torviello Orange. Primary action and highlight. 6.58:1 on midnight (AA normal text, AAA large).

warm-white.$description: Board: Warm White. Primary text on dark surfaces. 17.82:1 on midnight (AAA).

signal-teal.$description: Board: Signal Teal. Secondary accent for status and data highlights. 10.09:1 on midnight (AAA).

orange-hover.$description: Derived: orange lightened for hover states. 7.91:1 on midnight (AAA).

orange-light.$description: Board: light orange stop of the inference-flow stream gradient.

orange-dark.$description: Board: deep orange stop of the inference-flow stream gradient.

canvas.$description: Board: panel canvas near-black. Hero and brand panel fill.

deep.$description: Board: deep blue-black of the terminal showcase card.

elevated.$description: Board: elevated band behind the hero feature strip.

surface-glass.$description: Translucent glass card fill over midnight, as in the board hero cards.

surface-raised.$description: Raised glass surface (cards on hover, terminal block).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text. Blended over midnight: #b5b7bd at 9.44:1 (AAA).

action-label.$description: Label on primary actions. 6.58:1 on orange (AA).

accent-secondary.$description: Status-ready accent, data highlights, terminal prompt bullets.

surface-canvas.$description: Board panel canvas: hero and brand panel fill (slice 3, ticket 0038).

surface-elevated.$description: Elevated band: the hero feature strip (slice 3, ticket 0038).

accent-orange-light.$description: Flow stream light stop and INFER highlight (slice 3, ticket 0038).

border-panel.$description: Panel hairline on the board canvas (slice 3, ticket 0038).

border-panel-strong.$description: Stage and window hairline, stronger step (slice 3, ticket 0038).

glow-orange.$description: INFER edge glow and stream bloom (slice 3, ticket 0038).

focus-ring.$description: Visible focus indicator on dark surfaces. 10.09:1 against midnight.

family-mono.$description: Board: JetBrains Mono. Code and technical content.

size-small.$description: Board: strip subcopy and terminal transcript text (ticket 0038).
